# Expected changes for the “Radiant Depths” update on December 3rd, 2024 (Patch 56)

![Expected changes for the `Radiant Depths` update on December 3rd, 2024 (Patch 56)](/uploads/417_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update 12/02/2024] New challenges added

[Update 11/26/2024] Added Ping & Speech to Text feature

The next big free content update for Fallout 76 awaits us on **December 3rd, 2024**. There will be big new challenges with the **Raid "Radiant Depths"**, numerous **balancing** changes, new **legendary 4 star** weapons and armor, CAMP **Pets**, possible **new Milepost Zero employees**, numerous new **Atom Shop items**, the new **Enclaves Season 19 under the Name "Scientific Forge"** including a new weapon (**Tesla cannon**), **changed perk cards** and other interesting changes. New events are not included in this update.

### Index

## Raid: "Radiant Depths"

The new raid "Gleaming Depths" has been tested on the PTS and offers a completely new experience in Fallout 76. The raid's difficulty is significantly higher** than previous events, daily operations or expeditions. The aim is to provide a challenge for experienced players and requires teamwork for successful completion. The focus of the rewards is also on a new level, because it is possible to get 4 star mods and weapons with 4 stars multiple times in the raid. There is also a new power armor called "Vulkan" with a new set bonus that focuses on AP regeneration.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-raid-gd-ultracite-terror-20241005122436-1.jpg)

The raid is divided into **5 sections**. Each stage is a new challenge and gives you new rewards. Progress is saved after each section, so you can interrupt the raid at any time and resume it later. The progress of the entire group counts. If you are not a team leader, you can still continue playing in the same place in a new attempt with a different team. Furthermore, after each section there is an area with all the workbenches, stash boxes and punch card machines to optimize your equipment and perks.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-raid-gd-ultagenetic-horde20241004231837-1.jpg)

There is **no respawn** in the raid. If you die, you end up in spectator mode and can only watch your team. Only when the respective section is finished will you be revived. So you should be as prepared as possible in order to survive together as a team. For most players on the PTS, this meant switching to a full life build in power armor. You should also plan for poison resistance, especially in the last section.

![Gleaming Depths Raid Entrance](/uploads/nukaknights-post-raid-gd-location-20240929131826-1.jpg) 

The **entrance to the Radiant Depths raid can be found in Ash Heap**, right next to Strykers Row at the former rift location. You can only enter the raid via this entrance, both as a team leader and as a team member. All stash boxes and workbenches are now located next to the entrance if you want to prepare something beforehand.

More on this: Raid 'Gleaming Depths': Guide & Rewards (Gleaming Depths)

## New raid teams

There are new teams to match the new raid: RAIDS

The raid teams give a bonus to weapon durability:

- Base Bonus: +25% weapon durability
- 1 band bonus: +50% weapon durability
- 2 gang bonus: +75% weapon durability
- 3 gang bonus: +100% weapon durability

![Raid Teams](/uploads/nukaknights-post-raid-gd-raidteams-20240929134550-1.jpg)
